title: Guided Ride and Photoshoot
description:
A private guided road or gravel ride through the Marin Headlands, with photography along the way. I'll pick a route to match your pace, then photograph you riding the coastal climbs and Golden Gate views. You'll get a gallery of edited photos after the ride.

Priced per hour. Tell me below what kind of riding you'd like, and after checkout I'll reach out to plan the route, length and date.
imageAlt: Cyclist riding a coastal ridge above the ocean in the Marin Headlands
